name: Alpine A110 Pure (2018)
chassisNote: Mid-engine aluminium sports coupe; use chassis super with body.engPos mid (archetype would otherwise sit front-mid wrong).

gearset.src: Alpine / Renault press state a Getrag 7-speed wet DCT with ratios developed for the A110, but no public ratio table was found in the 2018 Pure brochure or Carfolio entry. Leave null — do not invent.

enginePreset.name: Renault-Nissan 1.8 TCe (Alpine A110)
enginePreset.note: Alliance 1.8 turbo calibrated by Alpine/Renault Sport: 252 PS (185 kW) @ 6000, 320 Nm (Carfolio peak at 2000 rpm). Brochure quotes hp without always stating PS vs SAE; 252 hp in Alpine copy matches 252 PS / 185 kW. Compression and continuous boost not in the Pure brochure (unsure).

sources.engine: https://www.auto-brochures.com/makes/alpine/Alpine_int%20A110_2018-4.pdf — 1798 cc, 252 hp (185 kW), 320 Nm. Carfolio Alpine A110 Pure: 79.7×90.1, 252 PS @ 6000, 320 Nm @ 2000.
sources.body: Alpine 2018 Pure brochure: min kerb 1098 kg, 4180×1798×1252, wb 2420, brakes 296 mm. Carfolio: Cd 0.32, frontal area 1.94 m², tracks 1551/1566.
sources.performance: Alpine Pure brochure: 0–100 4.5 s, top 250 km/h.
sources.gearset: Not published in Alpine Pure / Légende 2018 brochure or Renault UK Première Edition press notes (Getrag 7DCT mentioned without ratios).
sources.fit: Alpine Pure brochure: 205/45 R17 front, 235/45 R17 rear (Pure); double wishbone; 296 mm discs; 7-speed DCT.

note: Pinned 2018 Pure (not Légende / S / R). Factory turbo mid-engine car kept in NA Sports per shortlist. body.kg 1098 is Alpine's min Pure kerb. Published Cd 0.32 and area 1.94 m² (Carfolio). fWt 0.44 mid-engine layout estimate. Gear ratios deliberately null. Compression 9.5 is a typical figure for this Alliance turbo family (unsure) — replace if a maker sheet appears.
